title: 第13章 大壮~你快要把姐的魂儿勾走了
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
周香兰扭着性感的身子，走上前抓着李大壮的手就往屋里拽。

    周香兰的手虽然不如许红妆的那么纤细，但也柔软白嫩，一点都不像农村女人的手。

    她的背影更是婀娜多姿，波浪长发散在秀美的后背，散发出阵阵洗发水的花香味，水蛇腰扭来扭去，带动的翘臀也跟着扭动，碎花连衣裙垂到大腿处，露出半截白嫩嫩的美腿。

    一举一动间，全是少妇芬芳曼妙，李大壮真是想不通，这么漂亮的女人，她男人是咋舍得跟她离婚的？

    正想入非非呢，周香兰忽然停了下来，李大壮没刹住车，一下撞在了周香兰秀美性感的后背上，由于身高差，大腿还正好贴在周香兰的后翘上，这一下可给周香兰刺激坏了。

    李大壮宽阔的胸膛，精壮有力的大腿，都带着火热的温度，紧贴在她身上，惹得她碎花裙内的皮肉滚烫，尤其是那两座后翘，已经忍不住颤抖起来……

    李大壮感受着周香兰的曼妙，更是“火冒三丈”，那圆滚滚的后翘，咋就这么有弹性呢？

    “嗯~大壮，你个傻小子还挺有劲儿，差点没给人家撞飞~”周香兰娇软的嗔怪，声音也和后翘一样打着颤儿……

    “不好意思，香兰姐，我不小心的。”李大壮挠了挠头，有些依依不舍的后退。

    谁料周香兰竟反手按住李大壮的腰，将他紧按在自己身后，娇喘着说：“好大壮，别走，再跟姐贴一会儿~~姐这样，舒服~~”

    周香兰真是寂寞狠了，甚至都忘了李大壮可能已经不傻了的事儿，只顾着享受这一刻的放松……

    李大壮这下再也压不住了……

    周香兰自然能感受到他的变化，顿时张大了嘴巴，仿佛能塞得下两颗大鸡蛋！

    “大壮，你，你小子也太………”周香兰娇喘吁吁，空虚许久的身子，生出难言的渴望，恨不能化在李大壮怀里……

    “也不知道谁能有福气嫁给你，别说嫁了，就算是只能给你当相好，这辈子也值了啊！”

    “咳咳，香兰姐，别闹了，我一个傻子，给我当相好啥好值的。”李大壮嘴上这么说，身体却越来越不舍得撤离了。

    周香兰竟还不知轻重的晃了下身子，惹得李大壮热火冲天，重重的喘了口粗气！

    周香兰心中难耐，语气更是娇软勾人，仿佛浸泡了蜜水一般：“大壮~你快要把姐的魂儿勾走了。”
content_en:
Zhou Xianglan twisted her sexy body, stepped forward, grabbed Li Dazhuang's hand and pulled her into the house.

    Although Zhou Xianglan's hands were not as slender as Xu Hongzhuang's, they were soft and white, not at all like those of rural women.

    Her back is even more graceful, with long wavy hair scattered on her beautiful back, exuding bursts of floral scent of shampoo. Her waist twists and turns, causing her hips to twist as well. The floral dress hangs down to her thighs, revealing half of her beautiful white and tender legs.

    Every move she made was filled with the fragrant and graceful young woman. Li Dazhuang really couldn't understand why her man was willing to divorce such a beautiful woman.

    Just as she was thinking about it, Zhou Xianglan suddenly stopped. Li Dazhuang didn't stop the car and bumped into Zhou Xianglan's beautiful and sexy back. Due to the height difference, his thigh was right on Zhou Xianglan's back, which was very exciting to Zhou Xianglan.

    Li Dazhuang's broad chest and strong thighs were all with a fiery temperature, clinging to her body, causing the skin and flesh in her floral skirt to become hot, especially the two back seats, which could not help but tremble...

    Li Dazhuang felt the gracefulness of Zhou Xianglan and was even more "furious". How could those round back curls be so elastic?

    "Hmm~ Da Zhuang, you stupid boy is quite energetic, you almost didn't get knocked off~" Zhou Xianglan scolded softly, her voice was trembling like Houqiao...

    "I'm sorry, Sister Xianglan, I wasn't careful." Li Dazhuang scratched his head and backed away reluctantly.

    Unexpectedly, Zhou Xianglan actually pressed Li Dazhuang's waist with her backhand, pressed him tightly behind her, and gasped: "You are so big, don't leave, stay with me for a while~~ It feels so comfortable, sister like this~~"

    Zhou Xianglan was so lonely that she even forgot that Li Dazhuang might not be stupid anymore, and just enjoyed this moment of relaxation...

    Li Dazhuang could no longer suppress it...

    Zhou Xianglan could naturally feel his changes, and her mouth suddenly opened wide, as if she could fit two large eggs in!

    "Dazhuang, you, your kid is too..." Zhou Xianglan panted, her body feeling empty for a long time, giving birth to unspeakable longing, wishing she could be in Li Dazhuang's arms...

    "I don't know who will be lucky enough to marry you. Let alone marry you, even if I can only be your good match, this life will be worth it!"

    "Ahem, sister Xianglan, stop making trouble. I'm a fool, so it's not worth being your prime minister." Li Dazhuang said this, but his body became increasingly reluctant to evacuate.

    Zhou Xianglan swayed her body without knowing the seriousness, which made Li Dazhuang furious and gasped heavily!

    Zhou Xianglan felt unbearable, and her tone was soft and seductive, as if soaked in honey: "Da Zhuang~ You are about to take away my sister's soul."
